42    /**
43     * @example '#fa3cc2'
44     *
45     * @return string
46     */
47    public static function hexColor()
48    {
49        return '#' . str_pad(dechex(self::numberBetween(1, 16777215)), 6, '0', STR_PAD_LEFT);
50    }
51
52    /**
53     * @example '#ff0044'
54     *
55     * @return string
56     */
57    public static function safeHexColor()
58    {
59        $color = str_pad(dechex(self::numberBetween(0, 255)), 3, '0', STR_PAD_LEFT);
60
61        return '#' . $color[0] . $color[0] . $color[1] . $color[1] . $color[2] . $color[2];
62    }
63
64    /**
65     * @example 'array(0,255,122)'
66     *
67     * @return array
68     */
69    public static function rgbColorAsArray()
70    {
71        $color = static::hexColor();
72
73        return [
74            hexdec(substr($color, 1, 2)),
75            hexdec(substr($color, 3, 2)),
76            hexdec(substr($color, 5, 2)),
77        ];
78    }
